needs.thing: the Xeech-Leel's council house (a building Helstrom does not have): a hall open by day, the treasurer's room upstairs, a front door, a back door to the river landing (an Expert lock), a gallery door reached up the stilts, a strongroom behind an iron door (a Master lock) with the gold, the seal ring and the silver, six wardens at night, and the cook (to be added to Helstrom: its source has only a one-room house and a ship, so the building is made from Dragonthorn Manor of King of the Murkmire's Lilmoth with its barracks for the wardens, and the strongroom is added as one locked iron door and a room of Imperial pieces)

signs.detail: its door shows "The Council House of the Xeech-Leel"; inside, an iron door shows "Council Strongroom" (Master lock); the house behind shows "Council Wardens' Quarters"

needs.why: Met for the place's part. A Murkmire house south-east of the sacred tree, reached over the boardwalk off its porch, shows "The Council House of the Xeech-Leel" on its front door and opens on a copy of Dragonthorn Manor (the hall with writing desks and silver, the upper room that serves as the treasurer's, partition doors), open by day. A back door in its back wall, locked at Expert, opens towards the wardens' quarters; in the hall's back wall an Imperial iron door locked at Master leads to the Council Strongroom (a copy of Journey to Baan Malur's stone cellar). Six wardens keep the night watch round the house and sleep by day in the Council Wardens' Quarters (a copy of Dragonthorn Manor Barracks); the cook Gathe-Ru works in the hall. The gallery door up the stilts is the story's FreeClimb way in (thieves.md:333): the stilts and the upper floor's windows are there to climb, and no stair is added for it. The gold, seal ring and silver are the quest's own things.
needs.narrow: Nothing more to change for the place.

sight.said: A big council hall plus a guard post; its door reads Council House of the Xeech-Leel, it has a Council Strongroom door, and wardens stand outside.
